vb_textbox.text: The best gnomes seem to go in waves. I picked purple / red ones, and then when the mushrooms dropped down to 2 ish, switched to brown / green, then back again when these drop. I scored about 1000 points.NOTE - you can't pause it, so go to the toilet, grab a drink etc first if you want. And don't forget to press the space to collect your mushrooms
